notes.title: NEW LEVEL: Alpine Cathedral
notes.notes:
[u]Adding the new Alpine Cathedral Level[/u]

- 8th level Alpine Cathedral added
- Playable area outside of the starter garage added.
- 2 New Achievements
- Improved player camera stability
- Improved the options menus by adding an FPS option and moving the mouse sensitivity slider to the options menu, so players no longer have to press 'B' in game to bring it up.
- Mouse sensitivity now saves between levels and plays.

notes.title: Update for Jan 31st
notes.notes:
- All seven levels are unlocked and available to play!
- The final treasure hunting level will release April 30th

*Thank you to everyone who has played ASoTM and joined our mailing list. Going forward, our email updates will no longer contain ASoTM level codes, but news regarding our unannounced third game.*

notes.title: Achievements Hotfix.
notes.notes: - Fixed the issue of achievements not unlocking after beating a level.

notes.title: NEW LEVEL: Mesoamerican Valley
notes.notes:
-Level 6: Subterranean Trading Post has been unlocked.

-Level 7: Mesoamerican Valley has been added as locked. It will be unlocked on April 30th, 2023.

-To play locked levels early, join our mailing list. Link in-game.

notes.title: New level Update
notes.notes:
In this Update.

- Sunken Pyramid unlocked. Subterranean Trading Post available with early access code (unlocked December 30th).
- Added a section at the top right of the screen that displays the current objective.                          
- Revised the checkpoint system and gave the player a Pink Pyramid to follow for each checkpoint.  There's also a 'checkpoint reached' message at the top left of the screen.
- Added a new achievement for the new level.
- Added a new tutorial '!' at the beginning of the garage to explain the new level objective.

notes.title: Small Update.
notes.notes: - Modified the level select in the garage, so that levels can be played in any order.

notes.title: Small update July 22nd
notes.notes: - Made the first two screens (Company logo and Game name) Click-thru, so players can access the main menu quicker.

notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.notes: - Made a quick fix for the achievements.

notes.title: Update notes for July 21st
notes.notes:
- Updated the landscapes in the majority of levels.
- Updated the audio options, so they save in between levels and plays.
- Added steam achievements to the game for beating levels.

notes.title: Audio options added
notes.notes: Players can now use sliders to adjust Music, Ambient Sound Effects, and Misc Sound Effects volumes in the options menu.
